title: Azure Function cannot reach Gemini: Workload Identity Federation impersonation denied
scenario: ControlPilot's nightly Azure Function moved from a Google service-account key to keyless Workload Identity Federation. STS accepts the managed identity's Entra token, but impersonating the Gemini service account fails with PERMISSION_DENIED on iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken. The cloud team blames the token audience; someone suggests roles/owner. You get the credential config, provider, IAM policies, decoded token claims, logs and a local simulator.
task: Follow the call path hop by hop and find where and why it fails
Rule the audience theory in or out with evidence
Fix config/ with least privilege: only this identity may impersonate the service account
Write root cause, evidence and the rejected shortcuts in ANSWER.md
acceptance: The Function's token reaches Gemini in the simulator
Other identities, other tenants and other audiences are denied
No over-broad grants, no keys, provider settings unchanged
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md match the injected fault

practices.label: Week 7 Mon - Workload Identity Federation with other clouds
